getting-started-talking-to-kangai-mau.speaker: Kangai Mau
getting-started-talking-to-kangai-mau.text: Hello. I Kangai Mau of the Rantuki tribe.

options.text: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?

steps.player: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: I looking for someone brave to go on important mission for me. Someone skilled in thievery and sneaking about. I am told I can find such people in Brimhaven.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: I need someone to go on a mission to the city of Ardougne. There you will find the house of Lord Handelmort. In his house he has our tribal totem.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: We need it back.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: Lord Handelmort is an Ardougnese explorer which means he think he have the right to come to my tribal home, steal our stuff and put in his private museum.

steps.player: Ok, I will get it back.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: Best of luck with that adventurer.

steps.player: How can I find Handelmort's house? Ardougne is a big place...

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: I don't know Ardougne. You tell me.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: Let's hope I find some help soon.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: Adventure is something I may be able to give.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: I need someone to go on a mission to the city of Ardougne. There you will find the house of Lord Handelmort. In his house he has our tribal totem.

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: A proud and noble tribe of Karamja. But now we are few, as men come from across sea, steal our land, and settle on our hunting grounds.

steps.player: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?

getting-started-talking-to-horacio.speaker: Horacio
getting-started-talking-to-horacio.text: It's a fine day to be out in the garden isn't it?

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: Days like these make me glad to be alive!

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: My name is Horacio Dobson. I'm the gardener to Lord Handelmort. Take a look around this beautiful garden, all of this is my handiwork.

options.text: So... do you garden round the back too?

steps.player: So... do you garden round the back too?

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: That I do!

steps.player: Doesn't all of the security around the house get in your way then?

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: Ah, I'm used to all that. I have my keys, the guard dogs know me, and I know the combination to the door lock. It's rather easy, it's his middle name.

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: Hum. I probably shouldn't have said that. Forget I mentioned it.

steps.speaker: Horacio
steps.text: Trying to muscle in on my job eh? I'm more than happy to do this all by myself!

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-investigati.text: There is a label on this crate. It says;
Senior Patents Clerk, Chamber of Invention, The Wizards' Tower, Misthalin. The crate is securely fastened shut and ready for delivery.
You can see the gluey outline from where you peeled the address label off.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
investigating-the-gpdt-depot-talking-to-.text: Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a Wizard, and an inventor.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-talking-to-.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
investigating-the-gpdt-depot-talking-to-.text: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!

options.text: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Ah! My latest invention is my patent pending teleportation block! It emits a low level magical signal, that will allow me to locate it anywhere in the world, and teleport anything

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: directly to it! I hope to revolutionise the entire teleportation system! Don't you think I'm great? Uh, I mean it's great?

options.text: So where is the other block?

steps.player: So where is the other block?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Well... Hmm. I would guess somewhere between here and the Wizards' Tower in Misthalin. All I know is that it hasn't got there yet as the wizards there would have contacted me.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: I'm using the GPDT for delivery. They assured me it would be delivered promptly.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: The Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team. They come very highly recommended. Their motto is: 'We aim to deliver your stuff at some point after you have paid us!'

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: By all means! I'm afraid I can't give you any specifics as to where you will come out however. Presumably wherever the other block is located.

options.text: Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

steps.player: Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Okey dokey! Ready?

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Dipsolum sententa sententi!
(The player gets teleported to the GDPT Depot.)

options.text: That sounds dangerous. Leave me here.

steps.player: That sounds dangerous. Leave me here.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: As you wish.

steps.speaker: Wizard Cromperty
steps.text: Yes it is isn't it? Forgive me for feeling a little smug, this is a major breakthrough in the field of teleportation!

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-using-the-a.text: You carefully place the delivery address label over the existing label, covering it completely.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-using-the-a.player: Now I just need someone to deliver it for me.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-using-the-a.text: You have already replaced the delivery address label.

investigating-the-gpdt-depot-investing-t.text: There is a label on this crate. It says;
To Lord Handelmort, Handelmort Mansion, Ardougne.

options.text: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

steps.player: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

steps.speaker: GPDT employee
steps.text: Well... I guess we could do it now...

options.text: Thank you, it's interesting in here.

steps.player: Thank you, it's interesting in here.

steps.speaker: GPDT employee
steps.text: We're the premier delivery service in ALL of Gielinor!
This combination is incorrect.
The combination seems correct!

inside-the-mansion-climbing-the-stairs-w.text: As you climb the stairs you hear a click...
You have fallen through a trap!

inside-the-mansion-investigating-the-sta.text: Your trained senses as a thief enable you to see that there is a trap in these stairs. You make a note of its location for future reference when using these stairs.

inside-the-mansion-searching-the-chest-w.text: Inside the chest you find the tribal totem.

returning-back-to-kangai-mau.speaker: Kangai Mau
returning-back-to-kangai-mau.text: Have you got our totem back?
If the player does not have the totem in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: Bah, you no good.

returning-back-to-kangai-mau.text: If the player has the totem in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Kangai Mau
steps.text: You have??? Many thanks brave adventurer! Here, have some freshly cooked Karamjan fish, caught specially by my tribe.
You hand over the Tribal Totem.
Congratulations! Quest complete!
